what: The clay face kit's head as data (art #42): the pack head reshaped into the faces lab's egg-like bean head before the kit's features are seated on it, in the lab's order (order). nose_flatten pushes the pack nose back into the face (heads.flatten_nose); bean is the space warp onto a superellipsoid about the eye height (heads.bean_warp; hair_k: the hair and every head extra move with their nearest head vertices); bean_clay overrides bean for the clay head, as the lab's round B clay head did (clay_parts.py: dict(P['bean'], strength=1.0, power=2.5)) for the warp and the clean head alike; clean_head replaces the warped head above the neck by the closed bean itself (heads.clean_head, the lab's round B clay head: the pack's sockets and the women's missing skull gone), scalp_lift lifts the hair's shell off it per direction from the bean centre (heads.lift_grid and lift_by, the lab's scalp lift: thickness kept; a hat follows its hair's lift), then push_out moves the hair and every head extra out of what is left (heads.push_out, 4 mm clear, per welded position so the pack's split vertices stay together); rigid_margin is the margin under the kit's lowest mouth point down to which the face skin follows the Head bone alone (clayface/face.py rigid_full_z). Metres, the face toward -Y, world space at rest before the clay look's head scale. Read by tools/blender/um/clayface/kit.py (docs/faces.md, "The bean head").
